sloka: तथा हतो ऽतिवेगेन प्रहस्तो गदया तदा ।निपपात स्थितः शैलो वज्रिवज्रहतो यथा ।। ७.३२.४७ ॥
transliteration: tathā hato 'tivegena prahasto gadayā tadā ।nipapāta sthitaḥ śailo vajrivajrahato yathā ।। 7.32.47 ॥

translations.english: Thus struck by the mace with great force, Prahasta then fell down, like a standing mountain struck by Indra's thunderbolt.
